text: シーブルック・タウンはエイデン・クインランがボールを奪い、カラム・ヴァルガが69分に9.4メートルの距離からシュートを決めて同点に追いつきました。タリク・マーロウのスルーパスがアシストとなり、見事な連係プレーでした[#1448][#1446]。このゴールでスコアは2-2となりました。

trace.output: Brief: GOAL - Callum Varga (Seabrook Town) for fan audience in ja

- Callum Varga scored a goal with a 0.206 xG from 9.4 meters in open play, assisted by Tariq Marlowe's through pass [#1448, #1446]
- The goal was an equalizer, making the score 2-2 after Seabrook Town was trailing 1-2 to Harbour City [score_before, score_after]
- The goal came from a build-up starting with an interception by Aiden Quinlan leading to a 3-pass sequence over 15.6 seconds [#1442 to #1446]
- In the last 10 minutes, Seabrook Town had more possession (52.8%) and created more opportunities with 4 shots and 1 on target, compared to Harbour City's 1 shot and 0 on target [last_10_minutes]

- Seabrook Town capitalized on a midfield interception by Aiden Quinlan to launch a counter-attack, quickly transitioning from defense to offense [#1442].
- The counter involved a long progressive pass to Kian Adeyemi, who advanced the ball into the final third before short passing to Tariq Marlowe, reflecting effective use of quick, vertical ball movement to break the defensive lines [#1443, #1444, #1445].
- Marlowe delivered a key through ball assist to Callum Varga, who successfully finished the move within 9.4 meters from goal, demonstrating sharp attacking interplay and exploiting spaces created by the wide, crossing-oriented 3-4-3 formation used by Seabrook Town [#1446, #1447, #1448].
- Harbour City’s 4-2-3-1 formation with a patient short passing style may have been less effective here, as Seabrook Town’s higher field tilt (64.4%) and greater possession (52.8%) in the last 10 minutes facilitated their ability to regain control and execute this equalizing counter-attack [#last_10_minutes].
